'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jeffrey Johns DS Coruscant''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition)|SE-D-coruscant.gif|label=Coruscant}}
* '''Deck name:''' How Did You Fail Her?
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
